docs.message:
docs(pdt42): value chain of "Getting apps into use" as a Wardley Map (E5)

## Intent

Map how value flows today in the focus arena, from the user needs down to commodities. The map is the base for the Platform Plays in E6.

## Key changes

- A new E5 chapter starts from three user needs: students want to understand the subject for good grades, parents want the same with little time, and teachers want free time by keeping students busy.
- The value chain below them: the app, bringing it to students, discoverability, a signal of fitness for use, hosting, AI assistants, devices and connectivity.
- Every component has its evolution today, so the Wardley Map places it: hosting, AI assistants, devices and connectivity are commodities, bringing the app to students is a product, the app and discoverability are custom-built, and the signal of fitness for use is in genesis.

moved.why: Sets the evolution of the E5 components that this step left open; "Passt" confirms the proposal made at the end of i187.
